edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff USD 6,000,000 (the “Settlement Amount”) by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated by Plaintiff, within ten business days after execution of this Agreement by both parties.

2. RELEASE. Effective only upon Plaintiff's receipt of the full Settlement Amount in cleared funds, Plaintiff releases Defendant from claims arising out of the matters described in the Recitals and existing as of the date of execution of this Agreement. This release does not extend to obligations under this Agreement or claims that cannot lawfully be waived.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this settlement confidential, except that disclosure may be made to their legal, tax, and financial advisers who are subject to confidentiality obligations; as required by law, court order, or applicable reporting obligations; or as reasonably necessary to enforce this Agreement. Nothing in this Agreement prohibits reporting to or cooperating with a governmental or regulatory authority or making any other legally protected disclosure.
